notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience, a new update for Shadowgate 2 is available now!

[list]
[*] Fixed a soft lock that occurred during the fight with Jair after the player's death.
[*] Fixed the missing Black Eye model in the hint window.
[*] Fixed a soft lock that occurred when the player saved the game after completing the puzzle involving Behemoth's ribs.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Tree Spirit target did not disappear after its death.
[*] Fixed achievement-related issues.
[*] Fixed a soft lock that blocked the game when the player ran out of bolts while using the crossbow.
[*] Fixed a missing entry about the Flesh Dragon in the book.
[*] Adjusted the Djinn's HP in the final fight to 200.
[*] Fixed an issue where Djinn’s orbs in the final fight could not be attacked with the Winter Grasp spell.
[*] Fixed a bug where AoE spells dealt damage to the orbs even when they were not present.
[*] Updated spell descriptions in the spellbook.
[/list]

Thank you for your ongoing feedback!

notes.title: New update is available now!
notes.content:
Thank you for your patience, a new update for Shadowgate 2 is available now!

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could prevent the riddle from displaying in the book if it was not opened before the end of the first Djinn fight.
[*] Optimized visual effects on the Courtyard map.
[*] Added translation for the close button in hints.
[*] Fixed a bug that could make it impossible to interact with the Djinn (may require revisiting a blocked location with mysterious magic or, unfortunately, starting a new save in some cases).
[*] Eliminated some save/load issues.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented the relevant story in the book from being crossed out.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Player GUI would not appear if the player lost focus on the game at a specific moment (e.g., using Alt+Tab).
[*] Slightly nerfed the final boss.
[*] Fixed an issue where the inventory hint would display after every game restart.
[*] Nerfed skeletons in the dungeon.
[*] Additional minor fixes.
[/list]

Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback!

[b]Added February 21st:[/b]

[list]
[*] Balanced combat with one of the enemies in the dungeon
[*] Fixed possible softlock when using a spell on a blue crystal prematurely
[*] Resized some UI elements according to your feedback
[/list]

notes.title: Watch Shadowgate 2 gameplay!
notes.content:
Magic is fading from the land of Kal Torlin, and a sinister darkness creeps once more across the realm.You take on the role of Raven, the great-great-granddaughter of Lakmir the Timeless, as she embarks on a perilous journey to restore the ancient magic to its rightful place. 

With nothing but Lakmir’s Chrono-Orb and the company of her ever-sarcastic companion, Yorick, Raven must brave the twisted halls of Castle Shadowgate, where devious monsters and cunning puzzles await. To succeed, Raven must unravel the secrets hidden within her storybook, mastering six powerful schools of magic. Deciphering its ancient clues will mean the difference between victory… or an untimely demise. So take courage! 

The shadows of Castle Shadowgate stir once more, and the fate of Kal Torlin rests upon your shoulders!

Game Features:
- 3D rendered environments allow you to experience the magical keep like never before.

- Six unique levels, replete with devious puzzles that will test even the most seasoned adventurer

- A new turned-based combat system that requires deciphering Storybook clues and exploiting your opponent’s weaknesses with powerful spells.

- Move seamlessly through the Castle’s past and past present with a powerful Chrono-Orb.

- Utilize Yorick’s hints in your quest to find and use objects of interest that’ll prove most useful in unlocking new locations and progressing through the castle.

- Dive into Shadowgate’s unique ambiance through Rich Douglas’ signature soundtrack and sound design.

- Enjoy engaging storytelling writen by the original creators.

- Four characters fully-dubbed in English with localized text for Polish, French, German, Spanish.
